_comment: Label mapping for stage 2. Paths are relative to DRIVE_ROOT and must live under raw/. rule: emobank_valence (sentiment only) | identity | value_map (requires value_map). method: direct = human annotation (incl. deterministic transform of human ratings); mapped = derived from a proxy (subreddit, keyword, LLM output...). Missing label keys -> NaN.

emobank.notes: EmoBank columns: id, split, V, A, D, text. Its 'split' column is NOT treated as an official split for this task.

dreaddit.notes: Dreaddit human stress annotation (0/1). Official train/test split is kept.

zh_example.notes: FILL ME IN: placeholder only - no Chinese dataset has been specified. Replace files/columns/rules with a real source; use method 'mapped' for any proxy- or LLM-derived label.
